bio: Giulio Lombardo has undergone a profound transformation from visionary architect to pragmatic urban strategist. His abstract dreams of geometric perfection have crystallized into an understanding that Venice's true architecture lies not in marble facades, but in the invisible infrastructure that sustains life itself. Working at the granary has taught him to read the city through its most essential rhythms—the flow of grain that prevents famine, the careful calculations that maintain social order
